headline: Broad Airbyte egress paired with a local-only Godot RL agent creates data-leak and compliance risk; prompt-injection and capability-conflict are limited by missing shared channels.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented. Airbyte exposes only an API and broad network egress, while godot_rl_agents shows no I/O surfaces or inbound parsing path. Without a bridge such as filesystem, clipboard, or MCP, a prompt-injection pathway is not evidenced.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate hosts or containers.
Do not pipe Airbyte outputs into the RL agent as instructions.
Disable any shared clipboard or shared mount.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is later introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Airbyte touches business data and has broad network egress; godot_rl_agents is local-only with no data classes touched. If they share a workspace or Airbyte exports business data into files the other reads, sensitive business data can leak through the pair even though B itself shows no outbound network.
conditions: IF Airbyte writes business data into a shared directory that godot_rl_agents can read, leakage becomes possible.
IF the pair is run under a shared OS account with shared workspace access, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Separate workspaces and OS accounts.
Restrict Airbyte exports to a dedicated directory.
Verify godot_rl_agents has no access to Airbyte output folders.
Rotate any credentials stored alongside exported data.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent sandboxing and access controls.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airbyte has broad network egress and API access, while godot_rl_agents shows no network egress and no write surfaces. The profiles do not show overlapping mutable resources, so direct write contention is not evidenced; only unusual shared-resource setups would create conflict.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same filesystem, database, or git repo, capability conflict becomes plausible.
mitigations: Avoid giving both agents write access to the same resource.
Use separate service accounts.
Keep git/database writes disabled for the RL agent.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared mutable state is introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airbyte can produce data outputs, but godot_rl_agents has no documented downstream action-taking authority or parsing pipeline. The pair does not show a default path where B treats A's output as authoritative, so cascading error is limited unless an operator wires them together manually.
conditions: IF godot_rl_agents is configured to consume Airbyte outputs as ground truth without verification, cascading error risk increases.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between agents.
Do not auto-feed Airbyte outputs into downstream actions.
Label Airbyte outputs as untrusted inputs.
requires-engineering: add schema and provenance checks before reuse.

E_compliance.rationale: Airbyte touches business data and has broad network egress, while godot_rl_agents touches no data classes and has no network egress. No residency or certification mismatch is documented, so compliance risk is limited to operator-chosen data placement rather than an inherent pairwise violation.
conditions: IF business data processed by Airbyte includes regulated data and is routed into a jurisdictionally restricted environment, compliance risk increases.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Airbyte unless approved.
Document data residency for Airbyte destinations.
Confirm godot_rl_agents never receives regulated datasets.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for data-class routing.
